in_marathi.name: Champ
in_marathi.long_meaning: Champ हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Champat’, meaning ‘to subdue’ or ‘to conquer’. In Hindu mythology, Champat is a title given to gods and heroes who have triumphed over challenges or foes.
